scope: Static ownership documentation and source collision checks; no permissions or runtime dispatch.
semantics: Writer means the semantic admission owner of this surface, not every caller of its public API. Generic EvidenceJournal owns physical append IO; each supplied journal path has one declared semantic owner. Reader lists identify primary readers, not every transitive consumer.
corrections: Protected legacy BLD-1 eleven-field model emission and additive BOSS twelve-field deterministic projection are distinct interfaces; disposition remains required in BOSS.
Granite is required in the final build. Historical shadow names do not make it optional. Critiques and native forecasts remain producer evidence, never independent Frankie-agent findings.
Native BOSS has no knowledge store or Memory A writer. This is not a claim that the whole repository or the separate agent lineage has no memory writer.

The Dipole classroom is mandatory in the final composition. Its answer key and full grade are host audit evidence retained outside the model-facing principal directory; the principal sees only the model-visible contract, its own teachback and the correction it must acknowledge.

stores.location: Frozen prior bundle selected for Sunday comparison; deployment/run path supplied independently.
stores.protection: Immutable comparison input; no BOSS writer. Never substitute refreshed carry containing Sunday findings.
stores.attribution: Prior memory evidence is disclosed as prior memory, never independent current-run discoveries.

stores.location: Separate pinned agent lineage seed output, selected by its own --seed argument/default.
stores.identity: Seed source-file digests, mission pin, knowledge registration/bundle/receipt hashes.
stores.protection: Agent lineage writer exists; it preserves original44 VERIFIED findings and carries separately admitted NEW findings. This does not permit modifying frozen comparison memory.
stores.attribution: Only admitted agent findings with original attribution/provenance; producer forecasts never become findings automatically.

stores.location: Caller-supplied principal directory (adapter `directory`), required to be outside the frozen receiver checkout; the receiver preparation lands in its `receiver/` subdirectory.
stores.identity: adapter-config.json config hash (receiver root/commit, preparation, render); receiver preparation receipt bound to the handoff directory; attachment_hash; session-request/session-response pair; FRANKIE_BOSS_SESSION_RECEIPT_V1 receipt_sha256 minted by the host, never by the principal.
stores.protection: Create-once retention; a partial receiver preparation is renamed and kept, never overwritten or deleted. Model-facing surface: only the model-visible classroom contract, pre-message, teachback, acknowledgement, completion, transcript and receipt may be retained here by the classroom subclass. The teacher key and the full grade are never written into this directory.
stores.attribution: Session responses, lessons and feedback are principal-agent output under the host receipt. Classroom pre-messages and model-visible contracts are host-supplied inputs, not agent findings.

stores.location: Host-owned classroom audit directory (adapter `audit_directory`, default `<principal directory>/../classroom-audit`), refused if equal to or inside the model-facing principal directory.
stores.identity: classroom_binding_hash and teacher_key_hash from the validated classroom package; dipole-classroom-source.json, dipole-classroom-teacher-key.audit.json and dipole-classroom-post-grade.json retained create-once and byte-identical on re-retention.
stores.protection: Answer-key material (teacher key, full point-by-point grade) lives only here, outside the principal directory; re-retention with different bytes is a refusal. No writer other than the classroom adapter; the integrated and final adapters inherit this same admission.
stores.attribution: Deterministic teacher-key mathematics and host grading of the principal teachback; grades are host evidence, never principal-agent findings.

detects: New direct EvidenceJournal constructors including import aliases and module aliases.
Append calls on file-local constructor aliases or explicit journal/_journal attributes outside listed semantic methods.
Protected knowledge/MemoryA path writes/deletes/renames using literal path fragments, path variables and simple local aliases; BOSS imports of legacy admission/cognition modules.

Protected-path writes are forbidden unless the (file, symbol) is declared under declared_principal_directory_writers with its reason; a declaration for a symbol the checker no longer flags is stale and refused.
limitations: Static source checks, not a Python security sandbox or whole-repository single-writer proof.
Cannot resolve arbitrary dynamic paths, reflection, runtime reassignment, interprocedural aliases, subprocess IO or external code.
Dynamic journal path identity remains the callers checkpoint/lease responsibility; public owner APIs may be called by orchestrators.
Tests parse AST and read pinned external Git blobs; they never import legacy modules with top-level side effects.
sunday_20260915_package is the retained first-run package copy (gold standard, dates-only changes); its vendored modules are excluded so the live modules are the only scanned identity.

frankie_principal_adapter.py.reason: The principal adapter reads the frozen pre-Sunday knowledge receipt and bundle (read-only witnesses) and writes only its own principal-directory artifacts: adapter-config.json, the receiver preparation, prompt.md and the retained original render. The file-local checker taints every write in the file through those names; none of these writes targets a knowledge or Memory A path. Store: principal_session_artifacts.

direct_store_users.note: Audit finding 6, second slice (2026-09-17): every direct store user the collision check flags, with its semantic-owner decision. A symbol listed under journal_constructors/physical_connects below MUST appear here with its role; a blanket declaration would defeat the check, so each entry names role (reader | writer | creator | reader+creator), store and the evidence (the connect mode or constructor form).
